# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 52 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_052_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 52

**1** His disciples said to him: "Twenty-four prophets spoke in Israel, and they all spoke about you."

**2** He said to them: "You have set aside the living one who is in your presence, and you have spoken about the dead."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Twenty-four prophets" — the Hebrew canon as then counted (24 books)
- "Spoke about you" — the disciples claim the prophets are fulfilled in Jesus
- "The living one who is in your presence" — Jesus is here, alive; the prophets are dead texts
- "Set aside" — dismissed, disregarded; the living teacher displaced by the textual tradition
